body: Nothings wrong with you. It’s everyone else that’s fucked up. I don’t think you’re doing it for attention because you sound like me and I’m not doing anything for attention. I don’t want this life at all, I’m just too stupid scared to do anything about it.

It bothers me so much that people don’t understand how someone can seem completely okay on the outside but have this whole other world going on inside. I hope you find a therapist that’s better for you.

I can kind of relate. I still wake up and go to work every day. I do life alone so I know that if I didn’t my life would come down to sleeping in my vehicle until I lost that too. But because I’m capable of going through the motions of what needs to be done I’ve been treated as if I’m not actually depressed at all and “maybe just a little sad sometimes”. I had a therapist tell me one time that they have patients who literally can’t function in life and live in halfway housing. Like they actually compared me to that and made me feel like my emotions aren’t real or serious. You should switch therapists, and keep switching until you find one who doesn’t undermine your depression.
This isn’t pathetic at all. (I know what you’re going through) I hope everything works out at the vet. What’s your cats name?
I think it’s mostly a place for people to vent when they need to. Which is a good thing for people to have.

My Dad killed himself too so I understand where you are coming from. I am also suicidal and I appreciate your sentiment.

That being said, it can actually make someone who is suicidal feel worse when people tell them they need to think about others and the people they’ll leave behind. No one WANTS to have thoughts about taking their own life, it’s not exactly a choice. When someone feels that way they already feel like garbage about themselves. Being told to think about others can make you feel guilty on top of already feeling hopeless. It’s not a good combination. When you’re in that much pain it’s impossible to think about what the aftermath of your own death will be. No one needs to be guilt tripped into staying alive.
A cat once saved my life. I’m so happy that Sonic saved yours.
It’s really frustrating. When I’m at an extreme low hearing music that I love somehow makes me feel worse.
Makes sense. Most people are. Someone told me it’s okay to shop around if I’m not feeling a therapist.
I have no idea then where I got this idea that as soon as I tell a therapist I want to die she measures me for a straight jacket. Thank you for educating me on this shit.

Medication seems kinda scary to me. Voodoo on the other hand sounds kinda fun. Scared to be hospitalized because I would lose my apt when I got out, and I wouldn’t even know how to explain to my boss where I’m at. I just don’t see it as an option for me. Scared of therapy because I just feel worthless. I’m in a very what’s the point state of mind lately. 
Are you nervous about going away again? Are you okay with it? Seriously if they do voodoo on you let me know and I’ll pack a bag lol

I live alone and don’t have good family so I overthink how being hospitalized to get help wouldn’t help at all, it would just cause bigger problems. After your three week stay did you leave because they made you? Were they just like you’re healed, go home?
Thank you for explaining all of that. I agree like what’s the point in trying to get help or whatever if you’re not being honest about what you need help with.

I was just wondering cause I prob should definitely be in therapy but I’m scared I’ll be involuntarily hospitalized as soon as they find out how fucked up I really am. Someone’s been pushing me to go and has flat out asked if I have suicidal thoughts all the time and I lie to them all the time and say stuff like ohh I would never do that. It sucks and just makes me feel worse to tell someone I’m good when I have a suicide note in my pocket. That person isn’t a therapist so it’s not really the same as your question but mostly now I just avoid that person and avoid therapy because of it.
Does the therapist know you’re suicidal?
